signals.title: EU AI Act enforcement begins: High-risk classification now mandatory for financial AI
signals.insight: Article 6 enforcement activates today. Any AI system making credit, insurance, or investment decisions must now carry a conformity assessment and technical documentation. Most enterprise AI stacks built on hosted APIs cannot produce this evidence retroactively — governance must be architectural.

signals.title: India's DPDP Act data localisation rules finalize: All PII must stay within sovereign boundary
signals.insight: Final rules require all personal data processing for Indian citizens to occur on infrastructure within Indian jurisdiction. Cloud API providers routing through US/EU endpoints face compliance exposure. Air-gapped and local-first inference architectures become mandatory for regulated Indian enterprises.
signals.am_link_text: Sovereign deployment: air-gapped and local edge models

signals.title: Gartner: 78% of enterprise AI projects fail compliance audits — lack of deterministic audit trails cited
signals.insight: New Gartner report finds that probabilistic outputs from LLMs cannot satisfy SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence requirements. Organizations using post-hoc guardrails report 4.2x higher audit failure rates than those with governance-by-construction architectures. Cryptographic signing of model outputs identified as emerging best practice.

signals.title: Sovereign wealth funds increase allocation to AI infrastructure — $47B committed in Q2 2026
signals.insight: Institutional capital flowing into sovereign AI infrastructure at record pace. Pension funds and SWFs now require data residency guarantees, on-premise deployment options, and deterministic decision trails before committing. Cloud-only AI vendors losing institutional mandates to sovereign-first architectures.
signals.am_link_text: SWFI case study: evidence-gated institutional AI

signals.title: WebAssembly runtime adoption surges for edge AI inference — 3x growth in financial services
signals.insight: WASM-based inference runtimes enabling sub-10ms model execution on commodity hardware without cloud dependencies. Financial services leading adoption for latency-sensitive compliance checks and PII filtering at the transport boundary. Deterministic execution guarantees make WASM ideal for governed AI pipelines.

signals.title: Ed25519 adoption in enterprise AI audit chains — cryptographic non-repudiation becomes table stakes
signals.insight: NIST draft framework recommends Ed25519 digital signatures for all AI decision audit trails in regulated industries. Tamper-evident logging with cryptographic sign-off provides the evidence chain that post-hoc monitoring cannot. Organizations without signing infrastructure face growing regulatory exposure.

signals.title: Multi-agent AI systems face governance vacuum — no framework for inter-agent accountability
signals.insight: As enterprises deploy multi-agent orchestration, accountability gaps emerge. When Agent A delegates to Agent B which calls Agent C, who signs the output? Governed swarm architectures that sign every agent action and maintain provenance chains are the only compliant path for regulated deployments.

signals.title: Indian legal tech market reaches $1.2B — AI-driven case research and vernacular-first platforms lead growth
signals.insight: India's legal technology sector growing at 42% CAGR, driven by AI-assisted case research, document automation, and citation verification. Vernacular-first platforms serving tier-2 and tier-3 advocates seeing highest adoption. Sovereign infrastructure requirements accelerating as courts mandate data localisation.

signals.title: Air-gapped AI deployments grow 340% in defense and critical infrastructure sectors
signals.insight: Zero-network-egress AI systems now standard requirement for defense, energy, and critical infrastructure. Physical data diode updates replacing OTA. HSM key management and on-premise hardware mandated. Cloud AI vendors excluded from classified and critical-infrastructure procurement pipelines entirely.

signals.title: Video production governance gap: 62% of AI-generated enterprise video lacks brand compliance verification
signals.insight: Enterprise AI video pipelines producing content without brand governance gates, compliance checks, or deterministic rendering verification. Regulated industries require every frame to be traceable to an approved script and policy layer. Script-to-screen governance emerging as critical capability for marketing and training content.
